preConditions.onFailMessage: Stop factors #11 and #12 of the current group #3 need a REJECTED threshold
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM stop_factors.stop_factor f JOIN stop_factors.stop_factor_group g ON g.id = f.group_id JOIN stop_factors.stop_factor_condition c ON c.stop_factor_id = f.id AND c.result = 'REJECTED' AND c.operator = 'GT' WHERE f.id IN (11, 12) AND COALESCE(g.root_id, g.id) = 3 AND g.valid_to IS NULL

preConditions.onFailMessage: Group #5 must have exactly one current version
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM stop_factors.stop_factor_group WHERE COALESCE(root_id, id) = 5 AND valid_to IS NULL

changeSet.sql: -- Rules with a segment are limited to its products, months 25..36 apply to every product. -- lower() does not fold Cyrillic under the C locale, translate() does CREATE TEMP TABLE overdue_rule_product ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT r.segment, r.name, p.id AS product_id FROM (VALUES ('RETAIL', 'Online кредит'), ('RETAIL', 'Тунук онлайн'), ('RETAIL', 'Онлайн ИФЦ'), ('RETAIL', 'Тумар'), ('RETAIL', 'Кредитная карта'), ('RETAIL', 'BakAi сплит'), ('MSB', 'Онлайн кредит для ИП'), ('MSB', 'Бизнес Лимит') ) AS r (segment, name) LEFT JOIN public.product p ON lower(translate(trim(p.name), 'АБВГДЕЁЖЗИЙКЛМНОПРСТУФХЦЧШЩЪЫЬЭЮЯ', 'абвгдеёжзийклмнопрстуфхцчшщъыьэюя')) = lower(translate(trim(r.name), 'АБВГДЕЁЖЗИЙКЛМНОПРСТУФХЦЧШЩЪЫЬЭЮЯ', 'абвгдеёжзийклмнопрстуфхцчшщъыьэюя'));
